title: Design Your Personal AI Stack
description: Map out and commit to a personal AI toolkit that covers your core use cases without tool overload.
steps: List your top 5-7 recurring tasks where AI could help
For each task, identify the best tool based on what you learned in this course
Check: are you picking more than 3 tools? If so, trim — pick the most versatile
Write a 1-page "AI toolkit card": tool name, use case, and your default prompt template
Commit to using this stack for 90 days before evaluating
expectedOutput: Your personal AI stack document: 2-3 tools with mapped use cases and default prompts.
bonusChallenges: Share your stack with one colleague and help them build theirs
Set a calendar reminder for 90 days out to review and revise
